title: Prioritisation of issues relating to the care of adults in hospital who live with a childhood onset intellectual disability
summary:
The aim of the study is to identify relevant research questions concerning hospital care for people with childhood-onset intellectual disabilities. The study takes into account the perspectives of people with intellectual disabilities, their informal and formal caretakers and and clinicians that are delivering hospital care for persons with intellectual disabilities. 
In a first step, an online questionnaire will be used to collect open-ended questions and issues relating to hospital care for people with cognitive impairments from different perspectives. These open-ended questions and issues will then be clustered into research questions by the research team and prioritised by the study participants in a further online questionnaire.
Finally, the ten most relevant research questions will be identified and prioritised in a workshop.  
A steering group and an advisory board composed of people with cognitive impairments will support the entire research process.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Place of residence or work in Bavaria
Capacity to consent
Belonging to one of the following target groups:
- People with a childhood onset intellectual or complex disability 
- Relatives of people with intellectual disabilities
- (Specialised) staff in hospitals
- care providers in specialized living arrangements for persons with intellectual disabilities
Exclusion criteria:
Place of residence and work outside Bavaria
Minor age
Lack of capacity to consent
Not belonging to the target group
